title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. The Nasdaq fell 2.9% on Oct 30 (S&P −1.8%, its worst day since June) as Alphabet (EPS miss, free cash flow −$9.1B), Amazon (trailing FCF −$42.4B) and Intel (−~29%) sold off, even though Azure grew 48%, Google Cloud 103% and AWS 39%.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is proven; payback is the debate. Hyperscaler capex runs ~$815–855B, OpenAI's raise was reportedly cut to $20B at $1.25T, and Anthropic filed its public S-1 on Oct 26 (no price range yet). Palantir (Nov 2), AMD (Nov 3) and the Anthropic roadshow (from ~Nov 10) are the next reads.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes (this sector's page was last refreshed Oct 25, so treat it as a week old). Tesla's Q3 gave no dated Optimus milestones (R&D +69%, operating income −56%), Fanuc's ADR jumped 8.75% on a beat and Intuitive posted a record 546 placements.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Industrial and surgical demand is real (IFR sees 655K installs in 2026; da Vinci procedures ~+15%) but humanoid valuations still outrun shipments. The Agility SPAC vote on Nov 2 is the next listing test; its outcome was not confirmed when this brief was built.

sector_scoreboard.story: L3Harris moves from Watch to Core after Q3 (EPS +33% to $3.28, record $53.2B backlog at 3.2x book-to-bill, FY26 EPS guide raised to $12.25–12.35). The high-beta drone names sold off on Oct 30: Red Cat −10%, Ondas −9%, AeroVironment −6%.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is intact but the continuing resolution to Dec 11 still blocks new starts on 150+ programs including Golden Dome. Palantir (Nov 2), Rheinmetall (Nov 5), the Anduril tender close (Nov 9) and Ondas (Nov 12) are the next tests.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Cameco fell ~8% to a new low of $76.91 after an adjusted loss and a 20% production drop, Oklo closed at $25.25 (−83% from its high), and NuScale rose 7% on a Doosan manufacturing contract that is not a binding order. The DOE offered up to $5B in conditional loans for Constellation uprates.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Long-term uranium is firm ($96.50/lb) yet listed names keep de-rating, and no commercial SMR operates. BWXT (Nov 2), Centrus (Nov 4–5), NuScale (Nov 5), Oklo (Nov 6) and Constellation (Nov 9) report next.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. MP Materials fell 5% to $39.57 (52-week low $37.11), Goldman cut its target to $57, and lithium carbonate is down ~25% in a month to CNY 93,600/t. Freeport beat and guided copper volumes higher.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: China's suspension of its Oct 2025 rare-earth controls lapses Nov 10 with no renewal confirmed, and GM's cancelled VAC magnet deal shows Western capacity can lose anchor demand. MP reports Nov 5, five days before the policy binary.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. SpaceX gave back its earnings pop (SPCX $134.72 on Oct 30, −6.4% on the day, ~40% below the June high) and October was rough for the group (Rocket Lab −23%, AST SpaceMobile −33%, Intuitive Machines −27%). Private space investment still hit a record $20.8B in Q3.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Capital intensity is the bear case: SpaceX guides Q4 capex to $35–40B and Rocket Lab sold ~$1.94B of stock in September. Redwire (Nov 4), Rocket Lab (Nov 9) and a Starship Flight 15 attempt (NET Nov 8, unconfirmed) are next; the SpaceX–Tesla merger study has no terms.

sector_scoreboard.story: Enphase moves from Watch to Avoid after Q3 revenue fell 28.5% y/y, Q4 was guided to $225–255M and the stock dropped ~16%. GE Vernova beat and raised (backlog $197B) yet fell ~6%, and Barclays upgraded Tesla to Buy ($450).
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Margins are propped up by one-offs (Tesla's $526M tariff refund; Eos at a ~−54% gross margin) while China's export tax rebate ends Jan 1. Eos and Stem report Nov 5, Energy Vault Nov 10 and Fluence ~Nov 23.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Illumina fell 18.6% to $235.99 on a beat-and-raise (valuation after a ~157% run), Lilly lifted FY revenue guidance to $91–92B, and Eikon dropped 23.7% to $5.54, 69% below its IPO price.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: No AI-discovered drug has full FDA approval. Tempus (Nov 2), Recursion's REC-4881 webinar (Nov 3), Schrödinger (Nov 4) and Guardant (Nov 5) are the next checks; Intellia's PDUFA date is Mar 10, 2027.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. The group fell again with Alphabet's ~11% post-earnings drop (IonQ $30.04, −5.3% on Oct 30), and the Fed's two hike dissents add pressure on long-duration multiples. Quantum companies lobbied for policy support the same day.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Sector revenue is ~$1.5B against pure-play multiples of 46–430x sales, and IonQ's $2B raise keeps dilution live. IonQ and Quantinuum report Nov 5, Rigetti ~Nov 9 and D-Wave Nov 10.

cross_cutting_themes.title: L3Harris moves up, Enphase moves down: earnings quality, not narrative, moved the board
cross_cutting_themes.description: L3Harris goes from Watch to Core after a record $53.2B backlog and a raised guide, while Enphase goes from Watch to Avoid on a 28.5% revenue decline and a weak Q4 guide. Every other position held its stance in a week when most stocks fell.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Hyperscalers beat on growth but not on cash, and the market stopped paying for capex
cross_cutting_themes.description: Azure +48%, Google Cloud +103% and AWS +39% were met with selling because Alphabet's free cash flow was −$9.1B and Amazon's trailing figure −$42.4B. WSJ reports record CoreWeave put volume and hyperscaler credit-default swaps at 2021 highs; OpenAI's raise was reportedly cut to $20B.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The Fed held with two hike dissents; the VIX is back near 19.4 and gold fell below $3,900
cross_cutting_themes.description: Warsh's first FOMC held at 3.75–4.00% (10–2, with two votes to hike) and markets price a December increase. The 10-year eased to ~4.93%, WTI settled near $104, and gold lost 3.3% on Friday, so there was no safe-haven bid in the selloff.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Three dated deadlines: Nov 3 midterms, Nov 10 rare earths, Dec 11 funding
cross_cutting_themes.description: US midterms land on Nov 3, China's rare-earth suspension lapses Nov 10 with no renewal announced, and the continuing resolution blocks 150+ defense new starts until Dec 11.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Anthropic's public S-1 turns IPO supply from a rumour into a calendar
cross_cutting_themes.description: Anthropic filed publicly on Oct 26 (Nasdaq: ANT); WSJ cites a $100B+ raise at $1.5–2T for the week of Nov 16, with a roadshow from ~Nov 10 and no price range yet. SpaceX lockups add ~798M shares around Dec 8, and dilution (Oklo's ~$1B ATM, IonQ's $2B, Energy Fuels' $500M) is a recurring sector bear case.

news_of_the_week.title: Nasdaq −2.9% and S&P −1.8% in the worst day since June
news_of_the_week.description: Intel fell almost 29% on a weak profit forecast and Amazon's report raised AI-spending concern; the VIX rose 12.9% to 19.42 and the Russell 2000 still ended the week up 1.3% while the Nasdaq lost 2.0%.

news_of_the_week.title: Anthropic files its public S-1 (Nasdaq: ANT)
news_of_the_week.description: H1 2026 revenue was $16.3B with a net loss of $80.7B, mostly non-cash fair-value changes; WSJ reports a $100B+ raise at $1.5–2T targeted for the week of Nov 16, with no price range yet.

news_of_the_week.title: L3Harris raises FY26 guidance; backlog a record $53.2B
news_of_the_week.description: Q3 EPS +33% to $3.28 with 3.2x book-to-bill and $11B of THAAD and PAC-3 propulsion awards; the stance moves to Core.

news_of_the_week.title: Enphase misses, guides Q4 to $225–255M; shares fall ~16%
news_of_the_week.description: Revenue $293.3M (−28.5% y/y) and US sell-through −35%; the data-center IQ SST pivot is 2027–28 optionality, and the stance moves to Avoid.

news_of_the_week.title: Illumina −18.6% despite a beat and raised guidance
news_of_the_week.description: The stock closed $235.99 after a ~157% run-up on tariff and AI worries, while Lilly raised its FY revenue guide to $91–92B.

week_ahead.title: Palantir, BWXT and Tempus Q3; Agility SPAC vote
week_ahead.description: Palantir guided ~$2.16B (+83%); BWXT reports its first print since Investor Day; Churchill XI holders vote on Agility Robotics (AGLT if approved).

week_ahead.title: AMD Q3, US midterms and the Recursion webinar
week_ahead.description: AMD fell sharply in the late-October chip selloff; midterms frame the FY27 defense budget and tariffs; Recursion presents REC-4881 data.

week_ahead.title: Albemarle, Schrödinger and Redwire Q3
week_ahead.description: Lithium carbonate is down ~25% in a month; Centrus reports the same day with its call on Nov 5.

week_ahead.title: IonQ, Quantinuum, MP Materials, NuScale, Rheinmetall, Eos, Stem, Guardant
week_ahead.description: The densest print day: quantum guidance, rare-earth earnings five days before the China cliff, and the storage balance-sheet tests.

week_ahead.title: Oklo Q3 (pre-market)
week_ahead.description: Cash burn against a ~$1B at-the-market programme; Rocket Lab, Constellation and the Anduril tender close follow on Nov 9, and China's rare-earth suspension lapses Nov 10.

stance_changes.why: Q3 EPS +33% to $3.28, a record $53.2B backlog at 3.2x book-to-bill, FCF $1.3B and FY26 EPS guidance raised to $12.25–12.35, with $11B of THAAD/PAC-3 propulsion awards.

stance_changes.name: Enphase
stance_changes.why: Q3 revenue fell 28.5% y/y to $293.3M, the Q4 guide of $225–255M is weak, US sell-through is −35% y/y and the stock dropped ~16%; the data-center IQ SST pivot is 2027–2028 optionality, not current earnings.
